skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role of businesses in local economic development and their competitive capabilities.
Understand the role of government in managing local economic development.
Develop skills in strategic and organizational planning for local economic development.
Demonstrate independent work and social responsibility, with an understanding of professional ethics and continuous learning.
Analyze data to understand local economic development and business competitiveness.
Analyze policies and strategies for local economic development.
Conduct research and analyze data to support local economic development strategies.
Effectively present research findings and strategic plans for local economic development.
Work collaboratively in teams to develop and present local economic development strategies.
Demonstrate leadership in organizing and implementing local economic development projects.

prerequisite_courses: Public Administration in a Market Economy
